answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a beacon bet on surviving 101 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the thread schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 101 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
